lessons.frg04_effect: Makes the distinction program-explicit without creating a new admission mechanism.

lessons.swap_translation: Use F-RG03 rebaseline/aggregate snapshot versus atomic F-CI admission; require separate composition proof.
Generic bounded-object and composition rule across physics, solver, transaction, coupling and runtime objects.
Qualified negative outcomes may close hypotheses or block/reroute work but create no implicit production/completion credit.
R0-R4 SWAP-specific tiers based on physics, numerical, conservation, state/restart, transaction, coupling and composition blast radius; existing F-VQ gates remain hard.
Use explicit PROCESS/ADVERSARIALLY_SELF_REVIEWED_NOT_INDEPENDENT labels; never satisfy an existing independent F-VQ gate.

source_basis: ANIMO GOV05 first-head finding and remediated immutable-head re-review
lessons.swap_translation: Freeze reviewed authoring head; substantive post-review change requires a new head and affected/full re-review.
Reused evidence must match source/test/scope pins and retains its original provenance and assurance strength.
Use HISTORICAL_BEHAVIOR_UNKNOWN and RECONSTRUCTED_NOT_HISTORICAL; reconstructed replay cannot claim historical fidelity.
Do not copy ANIMO workunit families; bounded SWAP objects declare which surfaces are in scope and which authority proves each.
Compact SWAP evidence classes with explicit proof limits and consuming authorities.

lessons.frg04_effect: Preserved and reused for admission serialization and composition ownership.
Review/evidence checkpoints are additive resume metadata, not a new lifecycle.
Epistemic labels remain orthogonal to completion scoring.
Optional evidence/assurance/provenance/composition references are added conceptually, without mutating the existing schema or historical manifests.

lessons.reason: SWAP5 already has F-RG/F-VQ/F-CI/F-TB/F-DOC and canonical maturity conventions; importing B-levels would duplicate authority.
SWAP5 bounded objects are capability/contract based and need no TCD namespace.
SWAP5 retains F-RG03 approximately 4-6 substantive-closeout rebaseline cadence plus immediate rebaseline on material conflicts/gates.
Historical uncertainty/provenance principle is adopted, but SWAP does not need a B2 stage.
